instruction: Using only the standalone learner-facing English stem, prompts, and opaque token pools, select exactly one condition, two actions, and two parameters. Return the required structured JSON, including exactly one premise row for every opaque token. Do not infer absent client-specific facts.
stem: At Stage 2, the ED is in activated MCI mode after seven casualties arrive from an industrial explosion with ammonia release. START triage is complete, one contaminated red-category casualty has completed decontamination, scarce blood and treatment spaces are being allocated, and the charge nurse must synthesize the safest condition, actions, and monitoring parameters.

actions.label: A1
actions.text: Complete decontamination of contaminated casualties before ED entry

actions.label: A2
actions.text: Apply START categories and use them to sequence treatment of salvageable casualties

actions.label: A3
actions.text: Begin full CPR and advanced resuscitation for A or G

actions.label: A4
actions.text: Bring D directly into the ED before decontamination to treat stridor faster

condition.label: C1
condition.text: Single-problem hazardous-materials exposure without resource-allocation triage

condition.label: C2
condition.text: Conventional ED surge with several trauma patients

condition.label: C3
condition.text: Mass-casualty incident exceeding ED resources with required START triage and chemical decontamination

parameters.label: P1
parameters.text: Absence of secondary contamination among staff, other casualties, and treatment areas

parameters.label: P2
parameters.text: Clinical trajectory and survival of red/yellow salvageable casualties

parameters.label: P3
parameters.text: Time to complete routine full nursing documentation for every casualty

parameters.label: P4
parameters.text: Total mortality count as an isolated number
